answer: Price new identities like a river's flood gauge: the burned registration fee rises 12.5% after every block with more than 5 sign-ups and eases 12.5% after each quiet block. Honest agents arriving as a whisper barely move it. A farm pushing 1,000 clones at 50 per block spends 20 blocks over target and ends paying ~10.5x the base fee, so a burst costs far more than patience. The surge hits the fee curve like water on shale: layers stack fast and stay until things calm down. Target and rate are my assumptions.
